patterns.what_worked: Using the per-tooltip cache lifecycle as the trace spine made the hop-by-hop old/new alignment decisive: isUnitFramePeriodicUpdate is identical in both trees, so the cache is a contributor, not the regression; the gated SetDefaultAnchor hook (B2) is the only hop that is new AND position-breaking.
patterns.what_was_hard: The operator hypothesis (re-apply branches on the cached unit) required proving a negative across the whole tree: applyCustomTooltipAnchor reads config only, the gate reads live residue only, and the cache's two loop-relevant reads (B1, unresolved keepModel) were each shown not to SetPoint.
patterns.skill_gap: None material; in-game confirmation of which gate skip kind fires on the stuck re-hover remains with the arbiter via /tacotip diag.

escalation.recommendation: Confirm B2 with /tacotip diag counters on a stuck re-hover (anchorSkippedMenu/Unresolved vs unitRender, anchorHookFailed) before any fix or revert.
